title: HBO Max just launched TikTok-style shorts and AI search that's a spoiler nightmare
content_html:
Published Jul 28, 2026, 3:34 PM EDT

Sara Heritage is a tech and gaming journalist, who's currently making her way up to Master Ball rank in Pokemon Champions. Bylines in IGN, GAMINGbible, The Gamer and more. You can usually find her tinkering with tech, or restoring old consoles, always with one of her 3 cats nearby. Come and talk with her over on Twitter @SHeritageJourno.

Sign in to your MakeUseOf account

Summary

  • HBO Max launched Shorts (TikTok-style clips) and a conversational search to simplify mobile discovery.
  • Shorts uses AI-curated dramatic clips that tempt endless scrolling and can easily spoil big moments.
  • Conversational search (Android) finds shows by mood or vague prompts to make picking faster.

HBO Max just launched two new mobile features in the US: Shorts, which is basically a TikTok-style feed of quick highlights from their shows and movies, and a Conversational Search Tool that lets you find stuff to watch just by saying what you’re in the mood for. It’s all about making it easier to scroll, sample, and maybe actually pick something from their massive library.

HBO Max Shorts will show you the best scenes before you've watched the show.

Does everything need short-form content now?

If you need something to watch while you eat, this is a great way to get lost in scrolling and totally forget about your food.

The clips are picked by an in-house AI that scans through hours of shows to find the most dramatic or jaw-dropping scenes. Editors then choose the best ones, and boom, you get a vertical video feed. HBO Max says Shorts will eventually show up on more devices, add sports, and get better as people use it.

The idea is to showcase the best scenes and help you choose what to watch. But honestly, isn’t this just a spoiler minefield? Imagine getting the big Sopranos twist ruined in a random clip. Or having the ending of The Pitt spoiled before you even start. Why bother watching if the app spoils it for you?

If you actually want to try it, just tap the Shorts icon at the bottom to scroll through trailers, clips, and extras. The feed is tailored to your interests, so if something catches your eye, you can watch it right away or save it for later. Right now, it’s only on iOS for some users, but it’ll roll out to more people soon.

Ask HBO Max comes to US on Android

Is this a feature anyone asked for?

There’s also a new experimental search tool for adults in the US, starting on Android. Just hit “Ask HBO Max” on the search page and type in stuff like “in the mood for a comedy” or “best movie for a girls night in.” The app tries to figure out what you want, even if you don’t use the exact title. This will show up on more devices soon too.

“These new mobile features build on intuitive, familiar behaviors subscribers use every day. Both ‘HBO Max Shorts’ and ‘conversational search’ translate those behaviors into new ways to discover programming across the HBO Max service, making it easier and more seamless for subscribers to find something to watch," said Liesel Kipp, Executive Vice President, Product Management, Warner Bros. Discovery.

Honestly, given how much time you spend scrolling through its Shorts, just rewatch Succession. It’s the main reason I’ve kept my HBO Max subscription for so long.

概括

  • HBO Max 推出了 Shorts（TikTok 风格的剪辑）和对话式搜索，以简化移动发现。
  • Shorts 使用人工智能策划的戏剧性剪辑，会让人无休止地滚动，很容易破坏重要时刻。
  • 对话式搜索 (Android) 根据心情或模糊提示查找节目，以加快选择速度。

HBO Max 刚刚在美国推出了两项新的移动功能：Shorts，它基本上是 TikTok 风格的节目和电影的快速精彩片段的提要；以及对话式搜索工具，让你只需说出自己的心情即可找到要观看的内容。 这一切都是为了让滚动、采样变得更容易，甚至可以从他们庞大的图书馆中实际挑选一些东西。

HBO Max Shorts 将在您观看节目之前向您展示最佳场景。

现在一切都需要简短的内容吗？

如果您在吃饭时需要看一些东西，这是一个很好的方式，可以让您迷失在滚动中并完全忘记您的食物。

这些片段是由内部人工智能挑选的，它会扫描几个小时的节目，以找到最戏剧性或最令人瞠目结舌的场景。 然后编辑们选择最好的，然后，你就得到了一个垂直的视频源。 HBO Max 表示，Shorts 最终将出现在更多设备上，添加体育内容，并随着人们的使用而变得更好。

我们的想法是展示最好的场景并帮助您选择观看的内容。 但说实话，这不就是一个剧透雷区吗？ 想象一下，黑道家族的大转折在一个随机剪辑中被毁掉了。 或者在你开始之前就已经破坏了皮特的结局。 如果应用程序破坏了你的体验，为什么还要费力观看呢？

如果您确实想尝试一下，只需点击底部的 Shorts 图标即可滚动浏览预告片、剪辑和其他内容。 该提要是根据您的兴趣量身定制的，因此如果有内容引起您的注意，您可以立即观看或保存以供以后使用。 目前，它仅适用于部分用户的 iOS 版本，但很快就会向更多用户推出。

HBO Max 登陆美国 Android 版

这是有人要求的功能吗？

还有一个针对美国成年人的新的实验性搜索工具，从 Android 开始。 只需在搜索页面上点击“询问 HBO Max”，然后输入“想看喜剧”或“适合女孩之夜的最佳电影”之类的内容即可。 即使您不使用确切的标题，该应用程序也会尝试找出您想要的内容。 这也将很快出现在更多设备上。

“这些新的移动功能建立在用户每天使用的直观、熟悉的行为之上。 ‘HBO Max Shorts’和‘对话式搜索’都将这些行为转化为在 HBO Max 服务中发现节目的新方式，使订阅者能够更轻松、更无缝地找到要观看的内容。”华纳兄弟产品管理执行副总裁 Liesel Kipp 说道。 发现。

老实说，考虑到您花了多少时间浏览短片，只需重新观看《继承》即可。 这是我长期订阅 HBO Max 的主要原因。
